name: Insightful Investigator
texts: When you play me, choose an opponent. They reveal their hand. You may pay 2 XP to choose a card from their hand. If you do, they discard that card and draw 1.
manual: When you play me, choose an opponent.
You may pay 2 XP to choose a card from their hand.
If you do, they discard that card and draw 1.
